catalog_description: Know-your-customer and anti-money-laundering reviews assessing customer risk, ownership, source of funds, and sanctions screening, required at onboarding and annual recertification.
Posted transactions on a bank account: date, type, amount, currency, counterparty, and reconciliation status against the bank statement.
Seller-facing competitive cards showing how to win against a named competitor, with common objections and the counters to them.
Insurance providers, retirement recordkeepers, and benefit administrators that fulfill a benefit plan and receive enrollment feeds.
People covered under an employee's benefit plan, such as a spouse, partner, or child, with relationship, birth date, and eligibility documents.
Per-employee, per-plan elected coverage with effective dates, covered dependents, contributions, and beneficiaries. The basis for payroll deductions.
Annual windows during which employees may elect or change benefit plans for the next plan year, driving enrollment communications and carrier updates.
Employer-sponsored benefit offerings such as medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and retirement, with eligibility rules, contributions, and coverage tiers.
Post-initiative metric captures recording realized ROI, goal achievement, and variance against plan, closing the loop on the expected business value.
Controlled pre-release programs with a defined cohort, features, and date range for validating a product before general availability.
Interactive dashboards combining multiple visualizations, bound to underlying data models for self-service analytics.
Saved explorations and prepared queries authored for reuse in analytics and reporting.
Published reports authored and served for business intelligence, including workbooks, dashboard-bound reports, and saved views.
Scheduled delivery configurations that push a report or dashboard to recipients by email, chat, or webhook on a set cadence.
Catalog descriptions of intellectual works across all formats, from books and periodicals to audio, video, maps, and datasets, encoded in library standards.
Running on-account balances for a boater that fuel, store, and service charges post to, settled periodically.
Marina customers with contact details, communication preferences, account balance, and the vessels and contracts they hold.
Boatyard service jobs on a vessel, such as repairs, winterization, detailing, or commissioning, with labor, parts, and status.
Conversational AI bot configurations defining persona, instructions, system prompt, and disambiguation rules.
Deviations from brand guidelines detected automatically, such as off-brand phrasing or unauthorized terms, with violation type and recommended fix.
Reproductive events such as natural service, artificial insemination, or embryo transfer, with sire, technician, and date.
Breeding-cycle events such as joining, pregnancy test, and birth, with sire, dam, offspring, and birth weight, tracking reproductive performance.
Broken links found by automated audits, with source and target URL, status code, first-detected date, and how many pages are affected.
Pairings of a new hire with an existing employee for onboarding support, with scope, start and end dates, and meeting cadence.
Binaries, container images, and packages produced by a pipeline run, with type, version, registry location, and signing status, ready for deployment.
Property certifications such as LEED, BREEAM, or seismic ratings that support underwriting and tenant appeal.
Outbound bulk milk shipments to a processor or co-op, with pickup time, volume, quality grade, and hauler.
Hierarchical maps of an organization's business capabilities, with maturity and investment ratings and links to applications, processes, and owners.
Design-time definitions of business processes as diagrams, with version history, lifecycle state, and ownership, distinct from runtime executions.
Business rules inferred from event-log patterns, such as activity orderings, forbidden sequences, and decision thresholds, capturing hidden control logic.
Corporate journeys grouping purpose, dates, traveler, and booked segments into one unit that is approved, tracked, and reconciled to expenses.
Scoring models for prioritizing portfolio items by value, strategic alignment, risk, and dependencies, producing a ranked backlog.
Whole, half, or quarter-animal pre-orders, with deposit status, customer cut-sheet preferences, processor coordination, and pickup date.
Change Advisory Board meeting records covering agenda, attendees, changes reviewed, decisions, and minutes.
Two-dimensional drawings derived from CAD models, with their own revision, approval, and title-block metadata and a separate release cycle.
Metadata records for CAD parts and assemblies, tracking owner, check-in and check-out state, revision, and the file they reference.
Recorded sales calls with audio or video, transcript, participants, and topic and sentiment metadata, attached to deals for review.
Timestamped annotations left on a recorded call during review, tied to the moment in the conversation they refer to.
Common-area-maintenance expense pools allocated to tenants by pro-rata share, with gross-up, audit caps, and exclusion of capital items.
Reusable assessment definitions such as coding challenges, work samples, and skills tests, with time limit and scoring rubric, assigned to candidates.
Skills, cognitive, technical, or personality test results attached to an application, often sourced from an external assessment provider.
Per-candidate opt-in records for privacy and data retention, with consent type, jurisdiction, and granted and withdrawal timestamps.
Files attached to a candidate such as resumes, cover letters, portfolios, and signed disclosures, with document type, storage location, and visibility.
Threaded email correspondence with a candidate as a first-class record, capturing sent and received messages, the template used, and delivery status.
Single recruiter-to-candidate touchpoints across channels such as email, call, or SMS, with direction, timestamp, status, and content reference.
Internal-only recruiter or hiring-team notes on a candidate, with author, body, visibility scope, and optional mentions, never sent to the candidate.
Multi-touch automated outreach sequences targeting talent-pool segments, with cadence, step templates, audience filter, and lifecycle state.
Employee-submitted candidate suggestions linked to a requisition, tracking the referring employee, candidate, status, and any payable bonus.
Links between candidates and tags, recording who assigned each tag and when, with optional context.
Free-form labels applied to candidates to support segmentation, search, and pool inclusion, with name, optional category, and color.
People known to the recruiting organization, with or without an active application, carrying contact details, resume, tags, consent, and source.
Authoritative shareholder ledgers for an issuing company, listing securities, classes, holders, and transaction history.
Sales-capacity models setting coverage, ramp, and productivity assumptions sized against the revenue target.
Periodic resource utilization snapshots such as CPU, memory, disk, and throughput, used for capacity planning, trend analysis, and cost allocation.
Investor-facing notice documents for a capital call, in standard reporting format with publication timestamps, stored apart from the call record.
Per-investor line items against a capital call, with allocated amount, due date, funded amount, and funded date.
Notices requesting investor funding against commitments, carrying call amount, allocation, due date, and funding receipt tracking.
Building improvement, renovation, or expansion projects, with budget, timeline, and completion status.
Collections of physical or digital documents submitted together for automated processing, with source, capture date, document count, and status.
Automatically captured emails, meetings, and calls attributed to an opportunity and account, removing manual logging and keeping the record complete.
Real-time card pre-authorization events from the card network, with the policy decision, distinct from settled card transactions.
Authorization and settlement records from a corporate card feed, with merchant, category, amount, and posting date, matched to expense lines.
Coordinated care documents for a patient condition, with goals, interventions, target dates, responsible providers, and escalation triggers.
Worker-declared career interests, including target roles, mobility preferences, and timeline, used to drive internal-mobility matching.
Projected routes from a worker's current role toward an aspiration, with the skills required, distinct from employee-authored aspirations.
Outbound integrations that send enrollment and remittance data to a benefit carrier, typically as weekly batches whose failures cause coverage discrepancies.
Session-scoped carts holding products before checkout, with item quantities, pricing, and promotions. Abandoned carts feed marketing nurture.
Taxonomy of HR request types such as pay, benefits, leave, and policy, driving routing, SLAs, knowledge lookup, and trend analytics.
Case files for flexible, non-sequential knowledge work: containers of ad-hoc and planned activities, milestones, and gates decided at runtime.
Postings to a bank account such as receipts, payments, transfers, and fees, used to reconcile against journal entries and bank statements.
Call and screen recordings from contact-center sessions, distinct from sales call recordings.
Monitoring readings at critical control points in food safety, where a deviation triggers a corrective-action workflow.
Templates used to issue completion certificates to learners, carrying layout and dynamic fields.
Catalog of certification types, with issuing authority, validity period, recertification policy, and prerequisite courses.
Renewal cycles of an existing certification, distinct from its initial issuance.
Per-learner ledger of earned continuing-education credits, serving as evidence for professional licensure reporting.
Detected conflicts between overlapping changes or a change scheduled in a blackout window, recording the colliding changes and the resolution.
Change-data-capture stream metadata, including source table, captured columns, capture mode, and watermark positions.
Files pinned or shared at the channel level rather than on an individual message, with who shared them, access permissions, and expiry.
Membership records linking a user or external guest to a channel, with join date, role, notification settings, and access level.
Strategic plans defining which sales routes, such as direct, partner, or digital, carry which market segments.
Persistent conversation spaces that are private, public, or direct, with name, topic, members, retention policy, and guest federation.
Synchronous audio or video meetings spawned from a channel or direct message, with participants, duration, and recording and transcription references.
Files or links embedded in a chat message, with attachment type, size, upload time, and virus-scan status.
Individual messages posted to a channel or thread, with author, timestamp, content, attachments, edit history, and reactions.
Nested conversation branches within a channel message, with the parent message, replies, participants, and read state.
Transactional checkout sessions capturing customer identity, payment method, shipping address, and conversion into a final order.
Hazardous substances on hand, with quantity, location, and links to their safety data sheet and exposure limits.
Captured configuration states at a point in time, used for drift detection, approved-state validation, and audit evidence.
The configuration-item type hierarchy defining schema, inherited attributes, and class-level monitoring and discovery policies for the CMDB.
Single executions of a pipeline, with triggering commit, timestamps, duration, overall and per-stage status, and runner, used for delivery metrics.
Pipeline definitions for build, test, scan, and deploy, with source repository, trigger conditions, stage configuration, and secrets binding.
Edges in the configuration-item graph such as depends-on, runs-on, and hosted-by, the topology behind service mapping and impact analysis.
Allocations of claims to adjusters, with assigned date, caseload status, and reason, driving adjuster workload analytics.
Disbursements to a claimant, provider, or vendor, with amount, payment date, reference, and allocation to coverages.
Settlement agreements for a resolved claim, with approved amount, conditions, releases, payee, and closure terms.
Versioned, governed collections of approved contract clauses, often organized by jurisdiction or contract type, that authors draw from.
Professional-services engagement records with client, service line, scope, fee model, period, and status, distinct from the contract artifact.
